name: MultiCombobox
purpose: A searchable multiple-choice picker with removable chips and explicit selection controls.
description: A multi-select popover with Base UI Combobox primitives. Checked state and active keyboard focus remain independent. Type to filter, use Arrow/Home/End to navigate, Enter to toggle, Escape to close and Backspace on an empty search to remove the last selection. Select all applies to enabled filtered options. Set filterOptions=false for externally searched results.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description: Disable local filtering when results are supplied by a remote search.

guidance.overview: A searchable multiple-choice picker with removable chips and explicit selection controls.
usage: Supply stable values and optional keywords for local search. Set filterOptions={false} when the host supplies remote results.
Select all applies to enabled search matches and preserves other selections; Clear removes the selection.
maxVisible limits visible chips, not selected values. Hidden choices are named in the overflow summary.
accessibility: Arrow keys move the active option, Home and End reach the ends, and Enter toggles selection while focus stays in the search field.
Removing a chip moves focus to a remaining removal control or the trigger, avoiding a lost keyboard position.
Use loading for an actual pending result request; selection actions are disabled while results are loading.
context: Use for multiple owners, labels, sources, or project scopes that benefit from searching.
